text: I. Professional OverviewMathematics is a fundamental discipline that studies quantitative relations, spatial forms, structures and logic. It takes abstract thinking and rigorous reasoning as its core and reveals the laws of nature and the essence of science through symbolic and axiomatic methods. As a fundamental tool for all sciences, mathematics encompasses both the theoretical exploration of pure mathematics (such as algebra, geometry, and analysis) and the practical transformation of applied mathematics (such as probability and statistics, numerical computation, and mathematical modeling) in fields like engineering, finance, and computer science. Modern mathematics deeply intersects with disciplines such as physics, biology, and artificial intelligence, giving rise to emerging directions like computational mathematics, financial mathematics, and topological data analysis, which have become the core driving force for technological breakthroughs.Ii. Training ObjectivesCultivate compound talents with a solid foundation in mathematical theory, strong logical thinking ability and interdisciplinary application ability. Students are required to master the basic theories of core branches of mathematics (such as mathematical analysis and advanced algebra), possess practical skills in mathematical modeling, numerical calculation and data analysis, and be capable of engaging in theoretical research, teaching, algorithm design or data analysis in fields such as research institutes, higher education, fintech, information technology and engineering applications. Serve the innovation of basic science and the major strategic demands of the country (such as cryptography, artificial intelligence algorithms, and aerospace orbit computing).
